reason: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness utility for end users to manage installed Skills: it adds a Settings UI for installing, updating, and uninstalling Skills from GitHub, shows loaded Skills by scope, and can optionally include read-only Claude `.claude/skills` sources; evidence in the README and package metadata consistently describes this lifecycle-management purpose rather than core platform development or data analytics.

summaries.zh: 在 Settings 中集中管理 DeepSeek Harness Skills，支持从 GitHub 安装、更新和卸载技能，并查看当前已加载技能的作用域分组及可选的 Claude `.claude/skills` 兼容能力。
summaries.en: Provides a Settings-based DeepSeek Harness utility to install, update, and uninstall Skills from GitHub and inspect loaded skills by scope, with optional read-only `.claude/skills` compatibility.

capabilities: Install skills from GitHub sources (including tag or URL forms) into the local skills directory
Update and uninstall installed skills and maintain install metadata in a manifest
Read and display loaded skills grouped by scope (project/user/custom/bundled)
Load Claude-style skill definitions from `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` in a read-only mode
Configure GitHub download proxy settings via plugin settings

reasons.code: The plugin downloads remote skill archives from GitHub and extracts/copies them into local skill storage.
The plugin writes and deletes skill files under `<dshHome>/skills` and updates `<dshHome>/.skill-manager/manifest.json`.
A desktop install script is provided that patches host configuration files and restarts the app, requiring write access to app data paths.
